name: Virginia Governor's School for Agriculture
org: Virginia Department of Education, hosted by Virginia Tech
what_you_do: Spend three weeks at Virginia Tech in classroom, lab and field work on agriculture. Take core and chosen courses, learn about careers, and do a group project.
who_can_apply: Rising juniors and seniors from Virginia public, private and home schools. Selection is by your school or county, not by Virginia Tech.
pay_detail: Cost not listed on the program page.
deadline_text: 2026 session ran June 20 to July 11, 2026. Deadlines vary by school division. 2027 dates were not posted on the program page.
how_to_apply: Start with your school counselor. Or ask the gifted and talented lead. The Virginia Department of Education handles applications. They go through your school or county.
notes: Contact Dr. Brett Milliken, agschool@vt.edu, 540-231-6836 for cost and deadlines. Classes run 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. with evening and weekend activities.
